# Grassroots Books

> A community-focused independent bookstore in Reno offering free books annually, cash buyback for books/vinyl/comics, and literacy-driven community partnerships.

Grassroots Books is a Reno-based used bookstore that combines a free annual book program with buyback services for books, vinyl records, and comic books. The store emphasizes community involvement and literacy initiatives while maintaining an active events calendar and hiring program.

## Key Topics

- Free Book Program
- Book Buyback
- Vinyl Records
- Comic Books
- Used Bookstore
- Reno
- Community Literacy
- Events Calendar
- Outside Sales
- Bag Sales
- House Calls
- Gift Cards
- Donation Center
- Employment Opportunities
- Customer Service

## Core Services

- [We Buy – Grassroots Books](https://grassrootsbooks.com/we-buy): Book, vinyl record, and comic book buyback program details for Reno
- [Sales & Events – Grassroots Books](https://grassrootsbooks.com/calendar): Sales events calendar including outside sales and bag sales
- [Who we are – Grassroots Books](https://grassrootsbooks.com/who-we-are): About page detailing Grassroots Books company history and mission

## Community & Giving

- [We Give Back – Grassroots Books](https://grassrootsbooks.com/we-give-back): Community involvement and literacy mission with partnerships and research

## Customer Support

- [FAQs – Grassroots Books](https://grassrootsbooks.com/faqs): Frequently asked questions about free books, policies, and store credit
- [Wishlist – Grassroots Books](https://grassrootsbooks.com/wishlist): Book wishlist and request form for customers to find inventory
